name: libresign-agent-skills
description: Reusable workflows for reviewing pull requests, planning and executing issues, coordinating engineering investigation, diagnosing CI failures, auditing repository health, and analyzing upstream compatibility in free software projects.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement, diagnose and review software changes
interface.longDescription: Investigate and review code changes; plan and execute issues; coordinate temporary independent investigation; diagnose CI; audit repository health; and filter upstream compatibility changes against real project usage.
defaultPrompt: Review this pull request and prepare comments for me to check:
Re-review this pull request after the latest changes:
Draft issues and an epic for this project, including real dependencies:
Implement this already-scoped issue and prepare a reviewable pull request:
Diagnose this failing CI run and fix the causal problem:
Audit this repository for actionable maintenance debt and prepare a report:
Check relevant upstream changes against this repository and prepare a compatibility report:
